title: Freightliner Coronado High Tensile FUPS BullBar #7
description: Coronado FUPS compliant hi-tensile aluminium heavy duty Bullbar. 6mm wall heavy duty contoured upper high tensile pipe mounted full width heavy duty main channel with full width 16mm thick backing plate which incorporates the 38mm tow pin. Driving lights and Safety Signs are mounted on separate bonnet mounted light bar to customer specification. This Bullbar is built with minimum forward projection of 150mm to allow the unit to comply with dimension regulations.
